title: 第3章 引君入瓮京中烟雨楼第4章 沈仙子那年寒雪十里相送
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 京城之外，边疆。
骄阳似火，官道上常年被晒白的泥土，随着车轮滚动，碾碎成一阵阵狼烟白雾。
随行的众多护卫，经历过刚才一役，下意识目光看向车厢时，全都露出前所未有的尊敬。
对于孟尘这位六皇子，他们了解不多。
只知道他是众多皇子之中，身份最低，处境最惨的一个。
幼年被送入敌国为质子，母系一族不仅没被看重，反而被贬，如果不是赐婚这件事，他们心底都以为六皇子永远不可能回来了。
毕竟，如今五大皇子崛起，宛若真龙骄阳，各自手中掌控着庞大势力。
若真有好事，怎么轮也不会轮到六皇子这里？
对于京中的一些流言猜测，他们自然也是听到过的一些的。
对此，他们哪敢评判和猜疑，只想顺利完成任务罢了。
可经过这一劫，他们全都明白了，六皇子绝不简单！
能让一位秒杀大宗师的恐怖强者，如仆人一般跟随在身边，这足够说明六皇子的神秘了。
现在回想，众人皆觉得京中传言有些可笑。
世人都认为六皇子废物，是个弃子，即便被接回也不是因为突然得宠，而是当做一个平衡权力的棋子，注定要陷入风暴的旋涡。
殊不知，六皇子才是最有争帝的那一个！
车厢内。
孟尘闭眸，没有理会众人的心思。
他脑海中古鼎沉浮，眉心青光闪烁，抬手直接凝聚出一道青色玉简。
这上面，复制了灵虚阁的所有功法秘典。
刚才击杀那灵虚阁的长老时，他身上所有关于灵虚阁的修炼之法，都已经被孟尘得到。
“拿去。”
“灭了。”
孟尘随手一丢，直接扔给了剑老。
剩下的事，自然不需要他过多交代，剑老能跟随他这些年，自然比任何人都要明白他的意思。
“殿下放心！”
剑老神色激动，他终于可以出手，收起玉简之后，身影直接从车厢中消失。
剑老的离开，没有人察觉。
更不会有人知道，随着他的离开，灵虚阁高层一夜之间被灭了干净。
灵虚阁主的头颅，被一剑斩飞，当场毙命！
染血的头颅，顺着九百九十九道天梯滚落，吓得一众灵虚阁强者两腿瘫软。
虽然孟尘没有交代，但剑老还是忍不住逼问，想知道是哪一位皇子暗中派他们下杀手。
content_en:
Outside the capital, the frontier.
The sun was as hot as fire, and the dirt that had been bleached all year round on the official road was crushed into bursts of smoke and white mist as the wheels rolled.
The many guards accompanying him had experienced the previous battle, and when they subconsciously looked at the carriage, they all showed unprecedented respect.
They didn't know much about Meng Chen, the sixth prince.
All I know is that he is the one with the lowest status and the most miserable situation among many princes.
Being sent to an enemy country as a hostage when they were young, the maternal clan was not only ignored, but was demoted. If it were not for the marriage, they would have thought in their hearts that the sixth prince would never come back.
After all, the five princes are now rising, like real dragons and blazing sun, each controlling huge power in their hands.
If something good happened, why wouldn't it be the Sixth Prince's turn?
Naturally, they have heard some rumors and speculations in Beijing.
They don't dare to judge or doubt this, they just want to complete the task successfully.
But after this calamity, they all understood that the Sixth Prince was anything but simple!
To be able to have a terrifying and powerful man who could instantly kill the Grand Master follow him around like a servant was enough to illustrate the mystery of the Sixth Prince.
Looking back now, everyone thinks the rumors in Beijing are a bit ridiculous.
Everyone in the world thought that the Sixth Prince was a waste, an abandoned son. Even if he was taken back, it was not because of sudden favor, but as a pawn to balance power, destined to fall into the whirlpool of the storm.
Little did they know that the sixth prince was the one who most wanted to be emperor!
inside the carriage.
Meng Chen closed his eyes and ignored everyone's thoughts.
The ancient cauldron floated in his mind, a green light flashed between his brows, and he raised his hand to form a green jade slip.
On this, all the secret scriptures of Lingxu Pavilion are copied.
When he killed the elder of Lingxu Pavilion just now, all the cultivation methods of Lingxu Pavilion in him had been obtained by Meng Chen.
"Take it."
"Destroyed."
Meng Chen threw it casually and threw it directly to Jian Lao.
Naturally, he does not need to explain the rest of the matter too much. Jian Lao has been following him for these years, so he naturally understands what he means better than anyone else.
"Your Highness, don't worry!"
Jian Lao looked excited. He could finally take action. After putting away the jade slips, his figure disappeared directly from the carriage.
Jian Lao left without anyone noticing.
No one would know that with his departure, the senior officials of Lingxu Pavilion were wiped out overnight.
The head of the master of Lingxu Pavilion was chopped off with a sword, killing him on the spot!
The blood-stained head rolled down the nine hundred and ninety-nine ladders, frightening the legs of the strong men of Lingxu Pavilion to paralysis.
Although Meng Chen didn't explain, Jian Lao couldn't help but ask, wanting to know which prince secretly sent them to kill him.
"Luo..."
